name: S2. Customer lifetime value and recency
rawText:
# Do you know who your most valuable customers are and how their purchasing behavior is changing?
#  - Which customers generate the highest revenue from completed purchases?
#  - Who are our most frequent customers, and how often do they place orders?
#  - Which high-value customers have purchased most recently?
#  - Are our most valuable customers purchasing through multiple sales channels?
#  - Which customers contribute the most to our overall sales revenue?
#  - Are there high-value customers who haven't placed an order recently and may be at risk of becoming inactive?
#  - How does customer purchasing frequency relate to their total lifetime revenue?
#  - Which customers should we prioritize for loyalty programs and retention campaigns?
# __________________________________________________
CustomerLifetimeValue is OrderItems:
    Order.Customer.Id UserId,
    Order.Customer.FirstName FirstName,
    Order.Customer.LastName LastName,
    Count(distinct OrderId) OrderCount,
    Sum(Quantity * UnitPrice - DiscountAmount).Round(2) LifetimeValue,
    Max(Order.OrderDate) LastOrderDate,
    Count(distinct Order.Channel) ChannelsUsed
  Where Order.Status = <Completed> AND Count(distinct OrderId) > <1>
  Order LifetimeValue DESC, LastOrderDate DESC
  Take 10
id: Sales 2. Customer lifetime value and recency
